hypothesis_origins.originator: TASK-17 control plane from retained TASK-01 and TASK-10 evidence
hypothesis_origins.initial_observation: The retained TASK-10 quote-only panel for one selected mint deteriorated monotonically from 342.1660 bps at USD 10 to 1118.8821 bps at USD 100. TASK-01 H08 had already named execution capacity as a bounded notional-sweep question. This is one real point-in-time observation, not population evidence, fill evidence, NetReturn or alpha.

research_cycles.question: Do repeated matched quote-only panels show a reproducible rise in round-trip cost from USD 10 to USD 100, making a size curve necessary before future strategy-capacity decisions?
research_cycles.estimand: Median across complete matched panels of cost_bps(USD100) minus cost_bps(USD10), where cost_bps(n) is 10,000 times one minus reverse_sell_usdc_atomic divided by buy_usdc_atomic.
research_cycles.population_and_controls: Exact versioned hypothesis-watchlist members only; matched within token, triggered window, provider endpoint and version, and response class; frozen USD notionals 10, 25, 50 and 100; each reverse-sell input equals its preceding buy output; no-route, timeout and invalid response remain terminal nonnumeric observations.
research_cycles.required_output: One data verdict and a separately gated next action. Current verdict is LIVE_NON_RECONSTRUCTABLE_NEED; provider capture remains NOT_AUTHORIZED.
research_cycles.error_cost: A false safe-capacity conclusion can turn a paper edge into loss; rejecting a usable size is the cheaper error at this stage.
research_cycles.privacy_boundary: Public market identifiers and sanitized content hashes only; no credentials, account data, raw conversation, wallet material or personal data.

hypothesis_versions.statement: Across matched point-in-time quote panels, quote-only round-trip cost tends to rise as USD notional increases from 10 to 100; therefore future capacity decisions must use a size curve rather than one generic liquidity figure or a single quote.
hypothesis_versions.mechanism: Limited executable route depth and route fragmentation create nonlinear price impact as order size consumes progressively worse liquidity.
hypothesis_versions.falsifier: The bounded population falsifies the definition if median cost_bps(USD100) minus cost_bps(USD10) is not positive, no more than half of complete panels have all three adjacent cost increases, or the apparent pattern exists only during provider error or outage states.

decision_events.rationale: LIVE_NON_RECONSTRUCTABLE_NEED: one TASK-10 point is insufficient to estimate a population, while historical chain data cannot reconstruct provider quote responses, error states or local request timing for unobserved notionals.
decision_events.next_condition: Obtain a separate exact provider/API gate for at most 192 sequential zero-retry quote calls over 8 versioned watchlist members, 3 triggered windows and 4 buy/reverse-sell notionals, or close the candidate.
